faq.q: Which yacht is better for a party or group outing?

faq.q: What is included in the charter price for these yachts?

faq.q: Do both yachts depart from the same marina?

faq.q: Which yacht is better for a romantic or luxury experience?
faq.a: The Pershing 46 offers a more exclusive, high-performance feel with sleek lines and a luxurious finish, making it a strong choice for couples or small groups seeking a premium experience. The Azimut 39 is also comfortable but better suited to social groups.

data.body_html:
Choosing between the Azimut 39 and the Pershing 46 for your Marbella charter can feel like comparing two different philosophies. Both depart from Puerto Banús, both are head-turners, but they cater to different priorities. The Azimut 39 offers a proven, all-inclusive package at a fixed price, while the Pershing 46 leans into speed, style, and a more bespoke booking experience. This comparison breaks down the numbers, the feel, and the value so you can decide which yacht is right for your day on the Costa del Sol.

If you're still exploring options, our full Marbella boat rental guide covers every vessel in our fleet.

Size and Capacity: Azimut 39 vs Pershing 46

The Azimut 39 measures 12.5 metres and can carry up to 11 passengers. The Pershing 46 is longer at 14 metres but has a slightly lower capacity of 10 passengers. That extra metre in length on the Pershing translates to a longer bow and a sportier profile, but the Azimut makes clever use of its beam and cockpit layout to fit an extra guest. For groups of 9–11, the Azimut 39 is the obvious choice. For groups of 8 or fewer who value space to stretch out, the Pershing 46 offers a more exclusive feel.

Performance and Speed

The Pershing 46 is built for performance. Its deep-V hull and powerful engines deliver higher top speeds and a more exhilarating ride. The Azimut 39 is no slouch — it cruises comfortably and handles the Mediterranean swell with ease — but it prioritises a relaxed cruising experience over raw speed. If your plan involves anchoring at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for swimming and lunch, either yacht works. If you want to feel the wind in your hair and cover more coastline in less time, the Pershing 46 is the sportier pick.

Price and Inclusions

Here's where the decision gets concrete. The Azimut 39 has fixed, all-inclusive pricing: €749 for 2 hours and €2,299 for 8 hours. That covers a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras. The Pershing 46 is priced on request via WhatsApp, and generally sits at a higher price point due to its brand, performance, and exclusivity. For budget-conscious groups or those who want a transparent upfront cost, the Azimut 39 is the winner.

Onboard Experience and Layout

The Azimut 39 features a spacious cockpit with a dining area, a sundeck, and a small cabin below. It's designed for socialising — the layout encourages conversation and easy movement. The Pershing 46, with its longer deck and sportier lines, offers a more refined lounge area and a larger bow sunpad. The helm station is more driver-focused, reinforcing the sense that this is a yacht to be piloted, not just ridden. Both have a bathroom and basic amenities, but the Pershing 46 feels more like a luxury sports car on water.

Which Yacht for Which Occasion?

  • Azimut 39: Best for larger groups (9–11 pax), budget-friendly all-inclusive charters, relaxed cruising, and parties with drinks and snacks.
  • Pershing 46: Best for smaller groups (up to 10), speed enthusiasts, couples or luxury seekers, and those who want a bespoke, premium experience.

Both yachts can visit the same spots — Cabopino, Estepona, Sotogrande, or simply cruise past the Golden Mile — but the vibe on board will be different. The Azimut 39 is a sociable, value-packed day out. The Pershing 46 is a statement.

Booking and Availability

Both yachts are available for charter from Puerto Banús. The Azimut 39 can be booked directly via our site with fixed rates and instant confirmation. The Pershing 46 requires a WhatsApp enquiry for pricing and availability, which allows us to tailor the charter to your exact needs. If you're flexible on date and want a faster booking process, the Azimut 39 is the simpler route. For a more personalised experience, the Pershing 46 is worth the extra step.

Check out our complete fleet page to see all available yachts, including the Mangusta 80 and Azimut 58 Flybridge.

Final Verdict: Azimut 39 vs Pershing 46

There's no wrong choice here — only the right one for your group. The Azimut 39 delivers proven value, space for 11, and a stress-free all-inclusive price. The Pershing 46 offers prestige, speed, and a more exclusive atmosphere. If your priority is budget and capacity, go Azimut. If you want to impress and enjoy a sportier ride, go Pershing. Either way, you'll be cruising the Costa del Sol in style.

For help choosing, contact our team on WhatsApp — we'll match you to the perfect yacht.
